annotations.text: Three logo directions for Rockwell Gold, all set in the site's own system: Space Grotesk wordmark, JetBrains Mono descriptor, and the RM-STD gold tokens on the day-mode bone canvas. The GOLD descriptor swaps to SILVER / PLATINUM / METALS across verticals.

A — Bullion Index
Strongest at tiny sizes; the ingot-stack-as-rising-chart says "hard asset, traded live" in one shape. Tradeoff: most abstract — reads "market" before "metal" to some eyes.

B — Assay Dial
Most literal coin / bullion read; reeded edge doubles as market ticks. Tradeoff: fine reeding needs the stepped-down tick counts at small sizes (28 → 20 → 16 reeds).

C — Hallmark
Best provenance story (assay, serials, verification) — a mark you could literally strike into a bar. Tradeoff: quietest in a nav bar; less distinctive as a standalone symbol.
